levels.label: Provider-named static edges
levels.allowed_claim: The fixture exposes direct static consumer and test edges with a bounded-regex provider.
levels.forbidden_inference: Every runtime consumer has been found.

levels.label: Explicit blind spots
levels.allowed_claim: Dynamic loading is retained as an explicit unknown class rather than a known static edge.
levels.forbidden_inference: Unknown classes are empty or harmless.

levels.label: Source-bound next action
levels.allowed_claim: The receipt records the target revision, limitations, and a next test review action.
levels.forbidden_inference: The map is a merge verdict or complete risk score.

levels.label: Current dev checkpoint
levels.status_display: Fixture graph and checks reproduce on dev
levels.allowed_claim: The current dev head passes its local checks and reproduces provider-named static edges with a dynamic-import unknown.
levels.forbidden_inference: The current dev head has complete runtime, generated, external, or downstream parity coverage.

levels.label: Downstream parity
levels.allowed_claim: The receipt leaves a seam for downstream review tools.
levels.forbidden_inference: Deletion Proof and Contract Watch have consumed this exact receipt.

levels.label: External release
levels.allowed_claim: Hosting and external publication remain unverified.
levels.forbidden_inference: The graph case is live on GitHub, portfolio, or Handshake.
